verdict.rationale: Hightouch's own docs show syncs that run unattended on a schedule or trigger, report each run's outcome, and send failure alerts. It also documents automated journeys and AI Decisioning agents that bundle scheduling rules and guardrails for self-improving campaigns. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended background operation, and deeper documentation of how AI Decisioning agents run autonomously over time.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: A sync runs on the schedule or trigger you set, then reports the outcome of each run so you can confirm it worked.
Sync modeled data to sales, support, analytics, and internal tools on a schedule or when data changes.
Sync to 300\+ destinations in real-time or on a recurring schedule.
Each agent combines everything a campaign needs to learn and improve: an audience, goals, messages, scheduling rules, and guardrails.
Get notified when a run fails
